changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE p_script_plugin_operation_audit ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, plugin_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, revision_id BIGINT NULL, operator VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, success TINYINT(1) NOT NULL, detail VARCHAR(1024) NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_script_audit_plugin (plugin_key, id), KEY idx_script_audit_created (created_at) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COMMENT = 'Script plugin operation audit';
